statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let Q (n : ℕ) := (Nat.log 2 (n + 2)) ^ 2; let width (n q : ℕ) := (Q n : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * n); let K (n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), E ((k : ℝ) * β); let ram (q h : ℕ) := ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), E ((h : ℝ) * a / q); let kernelMass (n : ℕ) (b : ℝ) := intervalIntegral (fun β => ‖K n β‖ ^ 2) (-b) b MeasureTheory.volume; let modeledMajor (n : ℕ) := ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Q n), ((ram q 1 / (q.totient : ℂ)) ^ 2 * (starRingEnd ℂ) (ram q n)) * (kernelMass n (width n q) : ℂ); ∀ n : ℕ, 1000000 ≤ n → Even n → (n : ℝ) / 72 ≤ (modeledMajor n).re

plain_statement.en: For every even n ≥ 1,000,000, the real part of the Ramanujan-weighted major-arc model is at least n/72.
plain_statement.zh: 对每个 n ≥ 1,000,000 的偶数，拉马努金和加权的主弧模型实部至少为 n/72。

brief.en: Sum the signed Ramanujan coefficients against the truncated kernel masses. The numerical cutoff and parity give a uniform lower bound.
brief.zh: 将带符号的拉马努金系数与截断核的积分相乘求和。利用显式截断与偶性得到统一下界。
